attrs.evidence: governance/blind_run.mjs verifyLiveRun(), called by --freeze-candidate, --reveal and --complete. Falsifier B: reveal over a modified candidate is REFUSED and writes NO receipt. Gate `gov-nest`.
attrs.statement: A TRANSITION RECEIPT MUST MEAN THE INVARIANTS HELD, NOT THAT THE STATUS WORD PERMITTED IT. MEASURED against P4.7: freeze a candidate, edit its bytes, then --reveal -- the reveal SUCCEEDED and wrote an immutable REVEALED receipt, and only a later verification noticed the stale candidate. Immutability then made the wrong claim permanent. Every transition but --abort revalidates the whole live run against the tree as it is, immediately before writing its receipt; abort is exempt because a run that cannot be aborted when it is broken is a trap.
